baslik: The Nuclear Test That Poisoned a Paradise Forever
aciklama:
In 1946 the US detonated an atomic bomb underwater at Bikini Atoll - the test that contaminated an entire fleet and left a paradise uninhabitable to this day.

#shorts #history #nuclear #disaster #coldwar

sahneler.metin: One bomb made a Pacific island unlivable for eighty years.
Two million tons of radioactive water exploded into the sky.
It crashed back down and swallowed a fleet of warships.
So why is the island still poisoned today?
The bomb was detonated underwater, right beneath the ships.
The spray soaked every deck in radiation nobody could scrub off.
The fleet was never cleaned. The islanders never returned home.
Eighty years on, Bikini is still too radioactive to live on.

vaka.ders: underwater nuclear tests proved far dirtier than airbursts
vaka.yanilgi: Baker was meant to show how warships survive an atomic attack. The surprise was that ships left afloat could not be decontaminated.
vaka.tartisma: Should the Navy have run an underwater test knowing so little about radioactive spray?
